diffs.detail: 'Process perishable inputs the same day they arrive: coffee cherries must be depulped and fermented within hours of picking or they spoil.' → "Black holes: classify by mass — stellar-mass (3–100 M☉) vs supermassive (10⁵–10¹⁰ M☉) — and remember Hawking radiation means they evaporate, though solar-mass lifetimes (~10⁶⁷ yr) exceed the universe's age."

'Fix the site before optimizing the machine, because wind yield scales with the cube of wind speed and siting outweighs every downstream design choice.' → 'Coffee: process cherries within hours — washed (ferment 12–72 h, bright/floral), natural (dry 2–4 weeks, fruity but off-flavour risk if uneven), honey (partial mucilage, graded yellow/red/black) — then dry to ~11% moisture and medium-roast at 205–215 °C just after first crack.'

'Respect hard theoretical ceilings before chasing incremental gains: the Betz limit caps any turbine at 59.3%, with real machines at 45–50%.' → 'EVs: modern era dates to the 2008 Tesla Roadster; expect ~250 Wh/kg lithium-ion, battery costs down from ~$1,100/kWh (2010) to under $140/kWh (2023), and match charging standard to region (CCS, GB/T, CHAdeMO), with 800 V architectures adding 200 km in ~15 min.'

'Match hardware to regional standards instead of assuming uniformity: EV charging splits into CCS (Europe/North America), GB/T (China), and CHAdeMO (Japan).' → "Internet: trace milestones — ARPANET's first message (29 Oct 1969), TCP/IP flag day (1 Jan 1983), DNS (1983), the Web (1989–91), commercial opening (1995), search/Wikipedia/iPhone (1998/2001/2007) — and note backbone fibre now exceeds 100 Tb/s per pair."

'Add storage to any intermittent source so output survives past daylight: CSP with molten-salt storage delivers after sunset, where plain PV cannot.' → 'Photosynthesis: two stages — light reactions (thylakoids split water, yield ATP/NADPH) then Calvin cycle (RuBisCO fixes CO₂) — with field efficiency only ~3% and global fixation ~120 Gt C/yr; C4 plants win in hot climates.'

'Expect learning curves to collapse cost: utility solar fell over 80% from 2010 to 2021, and Li-ion packs dropped from ~$1,100 to under $140 per kWh by 2023.' → 'Solar: PV efficiency runs 20–23% commercial (33%+ lab tandem), utility-scale LCOE ~$0.048/kWh (2021, down >80% since 2010), China makes ~80% of panels, and CSP with molten-salt storage uniquely delivers power after sunset.'

'Keep operating parameters inside the safe envelope: turbines produce from ~3 m/s but shut down near 25 m/s, and green coffee must dry to ~11% moisture before hulling.' → 'Wind: siting dominates because power scales with the cube of wind speed; the Betz limit caps efficiency at 59.3% (modern turbines hit 45–50%), turbines cut in near 3 m/s and shut down near 25 m/s, and offshore capacity factors exceed 50%.'
